verdict.rationale: Kintsugi exposes filing APIs (Get Filings, Get Filings By Registration ID) with status/date/jurisdiction filters and a general claim of filing/remitting on schedule, giving ops some per-filing status visibility, but there's no evidence of a calendar view of upcoming returns, remitted amount fields, or downloadable filing confirmations. Missing for 10: upcoming-returns calendar UI, explicit remitted-amount reporting, downloadable confirmation documents.
